---
name: Lesson / content request
about: Suggest a new lesson, lab walkthrough, quiz, or track environment
title: "[content] "
labels: content
---

**Topic**
What should be covered (and which track it belongs to)?

**Type**
- [ ] New lesson
- [ ] Hands-on walkthrough for an existing lesson (`PRACTICE[slug]`)
- [ ] Quiz (`QUIZZES[slug]`)
- [ ] Track lab environment (`PART_LABS`)
- [ ] Boss lab (`BOSS`)
- [ ] Cheatsheet

**What the hands-on part should do**
The target (must be a local, intentionally-vulnerable lab), the technique, and how it's detected/defended.

**References**
RFCs, CVEs, MITRE ATT&CK IDs, vendor docs, etc.

**Notes**
Keep it lawful and local — no attacking systems you don't own. See CONTRIBUTING.md for how the data-driven
generator works.
